$comment: Source of truth for docs/compatibility.md. Edit this file, then run `npm run compat:build`. CI fails if the generated page drifts from this data (`npm run compat:check`).

runtime.note: Unchanged for every 8.x release. Enforced by the `engines` field, so npm warns (or errors under `engine-strict`) on older runtimes.

entries.title: Camoufox browser engine upgraded to 0.11.x
entries.detail: `@hieutran094/camoufox-js` moved from ^0.6.8 to ^0.11.2. Camoufox supplies the hardened Firefox build used to get past bank WAFs, so this changes which browser binary is downloaded on first run.
entries.action: Clear any cached Camoufox download so the new engine is fetched. If scraping starts failing right after this upgrade, remove the cache directory and re-run once.

entries.title: `OneZeroScraper` is no longer exported
entries.detail: OneZero moved onto the declarative Pipeline, and the standalone `OneZeroScraper` class was removed from the public surface. This shipped in a minor release without a breaking-change note - it is recorded here so the gap is visible.
entries.action: Construct OneZero through the factory instead of importing the class directly. Every other bank already used this form, so most callers are unaffected.
entries.before:
import { OneZeroScraper } from '@sergienko4/israeli-bank-scrapers';

const scraper = new OneZeroScraper(options);
entries.after:
import createScraper, { CompanyTypes } from '@sergienko4/israeli-bank-scrapers';

const scraper = createScraper({ ...options, companyId: CompanyTypes.oneZero });

entries.title: Switched from `playwright` to `playwright-core`
entries.detail: `playwright` bundles a browser download step; `playwright-core` does not. Browsers for this library come from Camoufox, so the download was redundant and made installs much heavier.
entries.action: None for normal use. If your own code imported `playwright` transitively through this package, add it to your dependencies explicitly.
